source_title: Innodata Investigation Notice: SueWallSt Notifies Investors of Pending Investigation Into Innodata (INOD) - PR Newswire
source_excerpt:
Days after a rally, Innodata shares fell nearly 20% before the opening bell on October 27, 2026, following a report of nearly 550 layoffs in India and the Philippines. The investigation concerns whether investors may not have been adequately informed of the risk of a reduction in business that reportedly led to the workforce reduction.
NEW YORK , Oct. 27, 2026 /PRNewswire/ -- Innodata Inc. (NASDAQ: INOD ) shares reversed on October 27, 2026, falling more than 20% in premarket trading to open at $48.40 after reports indicated that the Company had laid off nearly 550 employees in India and the Philippines. Innodata has not yet commented on the news. If you bought INOD and are now holding a loss, see whether your INOD losses may be recoverable . You may also contact Joseph E. Levi, Esq. via email at [email protected] or by telephone at (888) SueWallSt.
The selling hit before regular-session trading opened, but did not stop there. By midmorning, the stock was trading below $45, representing a decline of about 25% from the October 26, 2026 closing price.
According to the report, the termination notice for the 550 employees cited a reduction in business assignments rather than terminating the employees for issues of personal performance. In its most recent 10-K filing, Innodata indicated they "employed 10,107 employees," as of December 31, 2025, suggesting the cut likely represented more than 5% of the Company's global workforce.
SueWallSt notifies investors of a pending investigation into potential securities law violations, including whether Innodata may not have adequately disclosed the risk of a reduction in work for the region and the potential impact on the Company's growth narrative. INOD investors who lost money in the October 27 selloff are encouraged to submit their loss details for review or call (888) SueWallSt.
